scope: PROPOSED input bindings for eight distinct B01 capability-refusal host references; not an execution script or created visual evidence
requirement_authority: D-039/D-040/D-045 peer streams and hard WebGL ceiling
D-057 accepted control copy and radio order
scenario_scope: A current same-document semantic Services host remains open under its already applied delivery choice. A distinct 3D option was chosen as pending while available. Before explicit Apply, a current valid capability check establishes that the required WebGL context cannot presently be obtained. Apply refuses that pending option without applying a different stream, reloading or entering the World.
dynamic_binding_status: PROPOSED concrete evidence binding to existing no-silent-switch and current/pending rules; independent review required. This does not select a production detector, retry algorithm, capability threshold or browser support policy.
verified_capability_reason_fixture: this browser cannot currently obtain a WebGL context
accepted_notice: This option is unavailable on this device: {verified_capability_reason}. Your current stream remains active.
measurement_constraints: Synthetic supplied capability predicate for design review; not an actual observation on the founder's device.
The prior current 3D choices were validly applied earlier in the same visit. This is not first-visit admission of a saved 3D preference on a client already known to lack the required context.
All three 3D candidates exceed this supplied current capability predicate. S-SEMANTIC is permitted; it is never the refused candidate or an automatically applied substitute.

The selected current choice and current ability to render WebGL are different facts. Prior current HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW remains the delivery choice; no active 3D renderer is claimed in either semantic host.
Do not infer CPU/GPU/device class, permanent unsupported hardware, graphics score, thermal limit or a stable tier from a context result.

A null result alone does not establish why creation failed. Wrong/already-bound canvas mode, invalid configuration, an exception, stale/unknown observations and unrelated asset/transfer/HTTP failures must not masquerade as verified capability refusal.

The eventual detector must use a suitable correctly configured canvas/context and bind its result to the current candidate/attempt. That implementation and its public-boundary tests remain later work.

Attaching a probe canvas to the active Quick Access document would conflict with OBL-CTRL-05's no-canvas requirement. This fixture supplies the fact; it implements no detector or probe resources. A correctly scoped detached candidate/preparation check is not excluded by this DOM requirement alone; its configuration, intent, resource ownership and actual qualification remain implementation inputs.
rendering_requirements: Four peer labels in accepted order: Detailed 3D, Balanced 3D, Simplified 3D, Quick Access.
Group name uses current applied label; checked native radio represents pending refused candidate. Retain explicit separate Apply selection and advance advisement.
Include the exact accepted notice with only its verified-capability-reason slot substituted. No failure/error heading, danger styling, fallback label or automatic stream change.
Represent unavailable 3D choices in text as well as any non-color cue; preserve the semantic peer option and useful host content.
Use a separate developer/reference annotation to explain the chronology and absence of renderer; that annotation is not unapproved product copy.
Keep host-specific context rather than using one generic shared recovery card as proof of both templates.
Preserve location, open host, query/results and private process lineage; none of these static references executes or proves preservation.
Do not fabricate post-Apply keyboard focus, live announcements, native radio behavior or timed interaction proof from a static frame.
